findings.title: The remediation protocol has no bound on repetitions; a repeated failure is not detected by identity and the circuit cannot stop it
findings.recommendation: Have Session carry the per-fingerprint attempt count in its circuit seam instead of trusting the caller-supplied attempt: argument, and take the repetition ceiling from the rule's existing budgets["max_attempts"]; dedupe on the already-defined Tamoz::Circuit::Record::FailureEvent (gems/tamoz-core/lib/tamoz/circuit/record.rb:34), which already carries a fingerprint. A comparison at the existing seam, not new machinery.

findings.title: The human-approval gate for a self-protected rule amendment is satisfied by a caller-supplied string prefix, not by the approval-policy seam
findings.recommendation: Accept the approval decision object Tamoz::Approval::Engine#decide already returns (it carries the verdict and the policy revision) in place of the "human:"-prefixed String, and require the same for write_lifecycle_mode. The value already exists one gem over; no new class.

findings.title: Neither a remediation Outcome nor an escalation payload can be revived through the allowlisted loader
findings.recommendation: When H3 lands the durable owned issue record, key its id on the failure fingerprint already present in the payload (escalation_payload.rb:33) rather than the positional "escalation.N" counter. No protocol change.

findings.title: A family-unauthorized classification escalates correctly but is not counted as an abstention
findings.recommendation: Count family_not_authorized in the matrix's abstained axis (or add a refused counter beside it) in matrix.rb#tally. A tally change, no protocol change.

findings.title: The documented seam replacements have no non-test constructor; the protocol is complete but unreachable from production
findings.recommendation: None beyond what seams.rb already prescribes: when H3 lands, the durable circuit must carry FailureEvent#fingerprint so F20-REL-01 closes at the seam replacing the in-memory counter.

prior_findings.title: FailureRecord shared FailureEvent value + 0-ParameterLists fix
prior_findings.current_status: closed, verified; one gap carried forward
prior_findings.evidence: gems/tamoz-core/lib/tamoz/circuit/record.rb:34 defines FailureEvent with a fingerprint field; record.rb:346 and gems/tamoz-sqlite/lib/tamoz/sqlite/circuit_store.rb:126 consume it; test/circuit_record_test.rb:64 covers it. FailureRecord version-first gates hold in both entry paths (failure_record.rb:230-234, 278-283), both raising CheckpointVersionError, and the dead readers are gone. Gap: gems/tamoz-agent-healing/lib has zero references to FailureEvent, so the shared value is unused by this gem - the mechanism behind F20-REL-01. The #100 [major][SIZE] overage remains declined and silenced in .rubocop_todo.yml; not re-litigated.

b9_domain_data_check.evidence: Everything in the gem is machinery: Classification::CATEGORY_ACTION_FAMILY/REQUIRED_EVIDENCE implement the framework's own design §3 closed category taxonomy (classification.rb:51,72), Preflight::CHECKS implement design §5 protocol steps (preflight.rb:89), and RuleRegistry#amend is a fail-closed shape gate on caller-supplied reviewed-diff + approval evidence (rule_registry.rb:164-178), exercised both ways by test/healing_failure_contract_test.rb:390. No diagnosis catalog, compensation map, watch-property rule, prompt, preset, or fixture response appears as a Ruby literal. test/support/domain_loader.rb:7-13 and test/fixtures/domains/{aquaculture,climate,cold-chain,shipment,thermal-lab}.json were read to establish the correct shape.

blind_spots: No production caller of Remediation.run or RuleRegistry exists (repo-wide grep outside the gem returns zero), so the repetition bound was verified by driving the protocol directly rather than through a session; a future caller passing a monotonically increasing attempt: would make preflight.rb:118-124 fire, so blast radius depends on the H3 wiring.
Did not run test/agent_change_evaluation_test.rb or test/agent_acceptance_workflow_test.rb - present but neither references Tamoz::Agent::Healing (F23/F25 surfaces).

Did not audit the SQLite effect journal's own attempt accounting beyond the MAX_ATTEMPTS vs current_attempt interaction (gems/tamoz-sqlite/lib/tamoz/sqlite/effect_attempt_ledger.rb:48-56); that is F07's row.
Tamoz::Sqlite::CircuitStore is named in seams.rb:32-35 as the H3 replacement but was not read for Seams-interface compatibility.
The promotion lifecycle (H4) producer side lives in tamoz-evals (F26/F27); only the pure PromotionGate predicates were read.
tamoz-agent-improvement shares the bounded-self-healing vocabulary (improvement/errors.rb:5) and was not read; vocabulary-overlap belongs to F23.
